title: Consultation for Singapore’s Climate Targets to be Announced at UN Climate Change Conference 2022
what_it_is: Consultation for Singapore’s Climate Targets to be Announced at UN Climate Change Conference 2022

sections.label: Singapore climate targets consultations
sections.summary: Singapore is consulting industry, citizens and civil society, including an online REACH consultation, before finalising its 2030 NDC and climate targets later this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (a) what are Singapore’s climate targets that will be announced at the UN Climate Change Conference 2022 in November 2022; and (b) whether the Ministry have held consultations with civil society on the climate targets to be announced and, if so, what are they.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We are also reviewing our 2030 Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Under the Singapore Green Plan 2030, we have been consulting closely with industry and citizen stakeholder groups, including more than 1,200 youths and civil society representatives from green groups and NGOs, through various engagement sessions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Building on these efforts, the National Climate Change Secretariat has launched an online public consultation on Singapore's climate ambition via REACH.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Members of the public are invited to contribute views on their vision for a low-carbon Singapore and how the Government, businesses, communities and citizens can work towards it.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We are taking into consideration the views received from these ongoing consultations as we finalise our climate targets later this year.

sections.label: Consultation timing before COP27
sections.summary: The consultation ends less than two months before Singapore announces its NDCs at COP27, and the Government says it is in constant dialogue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Because, by the time we end the consultation, it will be less than two months before we announce our NDCs at the UN Climate Change Conference 2022 (COP27).

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Please be assured that the Government will be reaching out and we are in constant dialogue, whether it is on NDC or our ongoing Green Plan initiatives.
